en.topic_title: Third Hong Kong media outlet receives suspicious letter with unknown powder from UK

zh.topic_title: Third Hong Kong media outlet receives suspicious letter with unknown powder from UK

en.topic_title: Third Hong Kong media outlet receives suspicious letter with unknown powder from UK
en.topic_summary:
A third Hong Kong media outlet has received a suspicious letter containing unknown powder sent from the UK, marking the second consecutive day of such incidents.



Threatening letters containing unknown powder from the UK were sent to three Hong Kong media outlets. Photo: Screenshot, via Orange News.



Online media outlet Orange News said in a Facebook post on Thursday that its office received the letter, which purported to be a tip-off from “overseas readers,” but contained suspicious powder.
